Killing <strand/>Suspensded enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10% 
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 12%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Players: 15%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 30%

1? second cooldown between activations.
